customMethods.name: addLotOperation
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("addLotOperation called")
	
	userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
	lotOperationInfo = self.view.custom.lotOperationInfo
	assetInfo = self.view.custom.assetInfo
	orderInfo = self.view.custom.orderInfo
	config = self.view.custom.config
	
	lotOperationEventInfo = {'lotOperationEventId': None,  'lotOperationId': lotOperationInfo['lotOperationId'], 'assetId': assetInfo['assetId'], 'tStamp': system.date.now(), 'enabled': True}
	
	inputLotEvents = []
	outputLotEvents = []
	nonLotPartsUsed = []
	lotId = None
	lotName = ''
	
	parts = dict(self.view.custom.parts.lotEvents)
	for k,v in parts.items():
		if v['lotId'] is None and v['itemSourceName'] == 'input': continue	#We will add these as lot attributes		
			
		lotEventInfo =  {
						'lotEventId': None, 
						'lotId': v['lotId'],
						'lotName': v['lotName'],
						'lotEventQty': v['lotEventQty'], 
						'workOrderId': orderInfo['workOrderId'],
#						'assetId': assetInfo['assetId'], 
						'assetId': v['assetId'],
						'itemSourceId': v['itemSourceId'],
						'itemUnitId': v['itemUnitId'],
						'itemId': v['itemId'],
						'lotStateId': v['lotStateId'], 
						'lotStateReasonId': v['lotStateReasonId'], 
						'shiftId': None, 
						'tStamp': system.date.now(), 
						'comment':None, 
						'lotOperationEventId': None
					}
		
		if v['itemSourceName'] == 'input': inputLotEvents.append(lotEventInfo)
		elif v['itemSourceName'] == 'output':
			if lotEventInfo['lotId'] is None:
				if config['serialId'] is None:
					msg = "No serialization configured for this asset"
					system.perspective.print(msg)
					system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': msg})
					return False, msg
					
				system.perspective.print("Generating lot Number")			
				lotName, msg = system.kanoa.serial.getNextSerialNumber(config['serialId'], userId)
				system.perspective.print("Creating lot")
				lotId, msg = system.kanoa.lot.addLot({'lotName': lotName, 'itemId': lotEventInfo['itemId'], 'itemUnitId': lotEventInfo['itemUnitId']}, userId)
				system.perspective.print("addLot() returned %s %s"%(lotId, msg))
				if msg:
					msg = 'Unable to create new lot with name %s. %s'%(lotName, msg)
					return False, msg
				
				lotEventInfo['lotName'] = lotName
				lotEventInfo['lotId'] = lotId
				#Update the lotEvents with the new lotId
				self.view.custom.parts.lotEvents[k]['lotName'] = lotName
				self.view.custom.parts.lotEvents[k]['lotId'] = lotId
			else:
				lotId = lotEventInfo['lotId']
				lotName = lotEventInfo['lotName']
			
			outputLotEvents.append(lotEventInfo)
		else:
			msg = "No itemSource set for %s"%lotEventInfo
			return False, msg

	lotOperationEventId, msg = system.kanoa.lot.executeLotOperation(lotOperationEventInfo, inputLotEvents, outputLotEvents, userId)
	if msg:
		msg = 'Lot Operation Event was not saved. %s'%msg
		return False, msg
			
	#Now add in non lot parts used
	for k,v in parts.items():
		if not (v['lotId'] is None and  v['itemSourceName'] == 'input'): continue
		nonLotPartsUsed.append(dict(v))
		
	lotAttributeName = 'nonLotPartsUsed'
	lotAttributeId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('lotAttributeId', system.kanoa.lot.getLotAttributes({'lotAttributeName': lotAttributeName, 'lotId': lotEventInfo['lotId']}))	
	if len(nonLotPartsUsed) > 0:
		lotAttributeValue = system.util.jsonEncode({'assetId': assetInfo['assetId'], 'lotOperationEventId': lotOperationEventId, 'values': nonLotPartsUsed})
		lotAttributeInfo = {'lotAttributeName': lotAttributeName, 'lotAttributeValue': lotAttributeValue, 'lotId': lotEventInfo['lotId']}
		if lotAttributeId:
			lotAttributeInfo['lotAttributeId'] = lotAttributeId
			retVal, msg = system.kanoa.lot.updateLotAttribute(lotAttributeInfo, userId)
		else:
			lotAttributeId, msg = system.kanoa.lot.addLotAttribute(lotAttributeInfo, userId)
	else:
		retVal, msg = system.kanoa.lot.deleteLotAttribute(lotAttributeId, userId)
		if msg:
			msg = "Lot Attribute was not deleted. %s %s"%(lotAttributeId, msg)
			system.perspective.print(msg)
			system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': msg})		
			
	if msg:
		msg = "Lot Attribute was not saved. %s %s"%(lotAttributeInfo, msg)
		system.perspective.print(msg)
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': msg})

	self.view.custom.lotInfo.lotId = lotId
	self.view.custom.lotInfo.lotName = lotName

	self.view.custom.executionState.lotOperationEventId = lotOperationEventId
	
	return True, None
